description: Picks the best Pinterest board for each draft pin, using the same board matching as URL2Pin's own scheduler and Autopilot (it compares what the pin is about with each board's name and description). Each pick is a sure match, a weak match, or none. Nothing is scheduled. Use it to show the person where pins would go before schedule_pins.

account_id.description: Which connected Pinterest account. Default: the most recently connected one.

name: suggest_boards
title: Pick a board for each pin
